name: Psychological Jujitsu
summary: Simultaneous sealed-bid game where players use Ace-King to win a shuffled prize suit worth points.
rules_text: Remove one suit to serve as the prize pile, shuffle it face-down. Each player gets the full 13 cards Ace-King of another suit, Ace=1 up to King=13 high. Play 13 rounds. Each round reveal the top prize card. Players simultaneously choose one remaining card from hand as a secret bid and reveal. Highest bid wins the prize and scores its point value face-up; lowest rank is Ace. If bids tie for highest, discard the prize card and the tied bids with no points, or by variation discard only the tied bids and award prize to next highest. After 13 rounds highest total points wins.
rating_reason: Pure psychology strategy game, hidden information bluffing
